kultivator.test.help.title: Test commands (op)
kultivator.test.help.maks: /kultivasi uji maks — straight to True Immortal Peak: heavenly root, Heavenly qualities, every technique, full qi (the ascension event follows).
kultivator.test.help.ranah: /kultivasi uji ranah <realm> [stage] [layer] — jump to any realm with its techniques and full qi.
kultivator.test.help.tur: /kultivasi uji tur [seconds] — tour every realm for a few seconds each to see its effects, then get your real data back (/kultivasi uji tur stop).
kultivator.test.help.kit: /kultivasi uji kit — boxes with every mod item, pills of each quality, technique books, rare items, formation and alchemy materials.
kultivator.test.help.teknik: /kultivasi uji teknik — learn every technique, reset cooldowns and fill qi.
kultivator.test.help.more: More: /kultivasi debug tribulation test · heartdemon summon · enlighten · ascension start · alchemy give · murid summon · reset
kultivator.test.max: You stand at the summit: True Immortal Peak. Stay still a moment and the heavens will open.
kultivator.test.techniques: Test: every technique learned, cooldowns reset, qi full.
kultivator.test.tour.start: Realm tour: %s realms, %s seconds each. Press F5 to watch yourself. Your real cultivation comes back at the end.
kultivator.test.tour.end: The realm tour is over; your own cultivation is back.
kultivator.test.kit: Test kit given: open the shulker boxes.
kultivator.test.disciple.none: No disciple of yours named “%s” is nearby (use underscores for spaces, or “semua”).
kultivator.test.disciple.max: Test: %s now stands at True Immortal Peak with a heavenly root and every teachable technique.
kultivator.test.disciple.techniques: Test: %s knows every teachable technique; cooldowns reset, qi full.
kultivator.test.disciple.tour: Realm tour for %s: %s realms, %s seconds each. Their real cultivation comes back at the end.
kultivator.test.disciple.tour_end: The realm tour of %s is over; their own cultivation is back.
kultivator.test.help.murid: /kultivasi uji murid <name|semua> maks | ranah <realm> [stage] [layer] | tur [seconds] | teknik | bintang <n> — the same tests for your disciples, by name.
